_comment: Structured claim-source mappings returned by three research subagents. claim_key groups claims that are about the same thing; value/unit are set for quantitative claims.
topic: Generative AI in the music industry

claims.claim: The global market for AI-generated music was worth USD 3.9 bn in 2025.
claims.evidence_excerpt: We estimate the global market for AI music generation at $3.9 billion for calendar year 2025.
claims.document_name: Harmonic Insights: AI Music Market Report 2026

claims.claim: AI music startups raised USD 1.2 bn in the first half of 2026.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Disclosed rounds for AI music companies totalled $1.2B in H1 2026.
claims.methodology: All disclosed equity and convertible rounds of USD 1M or more

claims.claim: AI-assisted tracks earned 4% of streaming revenue.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Tracks flagged as AI-assisted accounted for 4% of royalty-bearing streams by revenue.
claims.methodology: Royalty statement analysis across 3 major platforms

claims.claim: AI music generation was a USD 3.9 bn market in 2025.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Vendor filings put 2025 AI music generation revenue at roughly $3.9bn.

claims.claim: AI music startups raised USD 0.8 bn in the first half of 2026.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Equity funding into AI music reached $800 million in the first six months of 2026.
claims.methodology: Equity rounds only; excludes convertible notes

claims.claim: A major label signed a catalogue licensing deal with the AI startup Melodia.
claims.evidence_excerpt: The agreement lets Melodia train on the label's back catalogue in exchange for revenue share.

claims.claim: An artists' union sued an AI developer over the use of members' recordings as training data.
claims.evidence_excerpt: The complaint alleges recordings were used for training without consent or payment.

claims.claim: An artists' union has filed suit against an AI developer over training on members' recordings.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Union leaders said members never agreed to their recordings being used as training data.

claims.claim: AI-assisted tracks earned 9% of streaming revenue.
claims.evidence_excerpt: In the first half of 2026, AI-assisted tracks reached 9% of streaming revenue.
claims.methodology: Royalty statement analysis across 3 major platforms

claims.claim: Audio watermarks survived MP3 compression at 128 kbps in 97% of test clips.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Watermark recovery after 128 kbps MP3 re-encoding succeeded for 97.1% of clips.
claims.document_name: Robust Audio Watermarking for Generative Music (AudioSec 2026)

claims.claim: Classifiers detected AI-generated vocals with 94% accuracy on a held-out test set.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Our detector reaches 94.0% accuracy on held-out tracks, falling to 71% on generators unseen in training.
claims.methodology: Held-out test set of 4,200 tracks; accuracy drops on unseen generators

claims.claim: Watermarks remained detectable after 128 kbps MP3 compression in 97% of clips.
claims.evidence_excerpt: We reproduce the 97% survival rate at 128 kbps on an independent clip set.
